items.title: DoorDash (DASH) Becomes Official On Demand Delivery Partner Across North America
items.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) has been named the Official On Demand Delivery and Pick Up Partner of the NHL across North America. The multiyear agreement covers both the United States and Canada and includes exclusivity within the on demand delivery category. DoorDash branding will appear during nationally televised NHL games, major league events and across league digital platforms throughout the season. items.title: Costco’s DoorDash Launch Came Too Late to Touch the Quarter It Reports September 24
